input.fnol: Heavy rain overnight; water came in under the back door and through a basement window well. Basement carpet and drywall soaked.

citations.why: Water entered basement via window well and door during rainstorm
Loss was sudden, not continuous seepage

facts: Loss date 2025-08-11, heavy rain (≈90 mm/3 h) caused water to enter basement through window well and rear door
Damage: carpet $4,200; drywall & paint $3,900; dehumidifier hire $650; total $8,750
No nearby river/stream overflow; creek stayed within banks

{"loss_date": "2025-08-11", "rule": "edition in force on the loss date", "passages": [{"chunk_id": "NG-1101_07-23_sa_chunk_003", "form_number": "NG-1101", "edition": "07-23", "clause_id": "CLAUSE-WE-1", "text": "CLAUSE WE-1 — SUDDEN ESCAPE OF WATER
We cover direct physical damage to the dwelling and to personal property
caused by the sudden and accidental escape of water or steam from a plumbing,
heating, air conditioning or fire sprinkler system, or from a household
appliance. An escape is "sudden" only if it continued for fewer than ten (10)
days before it was discovered. An escape that continued for ten days or more
is treated as seepage under exclusion E-41."}, {"chunk_id": "NG-1101_07-23_sa_chunk_004", "form_number": "NG-1101", "edition": "07-23", "clause_id": "CLAUSE-WE-2", "text": "CLAUSE WE-2 — ACCESS AND TEAR-OUT
When a covered escape of water happens inside a wall, floor or ceiling, we
also pay the reasonable cost to open and restore that part of the building so
the system can be reached. Access and tear-out is limited to a sublimit of
$2,500 per occurrence."}, {"chunk_id": "NG-1101_07-23_sa_chunk_005", "form_number": "NG-1101", "edition": "07-23", "clause_id": "CLAUSE-WE-3", "text": "CLAUSE WE-3 — HOW WE PAY
The all-peril deductible shown in the Declarations applies once per
occurrence. We subtract the deductible from the covered loss first. Where a
sublimit applies, we then cap the result at that sublimit."}, {"chunk_id": "NG-1101_07-23_sa_chunk_006", "form_number": "NG-1101", "edition": "07-23", "clause_id": "CLAUSE-WE-4", "text": "CLAUSE WE-4 — RAINWATER AND SURFACE RUNOFF
We cover direct physical damage to the dwelling and to personal property
caused by rainwater or surface runoff that enters the dwelling at or below
ground level during or immediately after a rainstorm, through a door, window,
window well, air brick or other opening. The most we pay under this clause is
a sublimit of $10,000 per occurrence, after the deductible. This clause does
not cover flood as defined in exclusion E-42."}, {"chunk_id": "NG-1101_07-23_sa_chunk_007", "form_number": "NG-1101", "edition": "07-23", "clause_id": "SECTION-II", "text": "SECTION II — EXCLUSIONS
The codes below apply to this endorsement. A loss matching any row is not
covered, except where the row says otherwise."}, {"chunk_id": "NG-1101_07-23_sa_chunk_008", "form_number": "NG-1101", "edition": "07-23", "clause_id": "EXCLUSION-TABLE", "text": "EXCLUSION TABLE — NG-1101 ed. 07-23

| Code | Excluded Peril                        | Scope                                                                 |
|------|---------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| E-41 | Continuous or repeated seepage        | Water that escaped for 10 or more days before discovery, and any rot, |
|      |                                       | rust or deterioration it caused                                       |
| E-42 | Flood                                 | The overflow of a river, stream, lake or the sea onto normally dry    |
|      |                                       | land, including storm surge; rainwater and surface runoff are dealt   |
|      |                                       | with under WE-4, not under this exclusion                             |
| E-43 | Sewer and drain backup                | Water or sewage backing up through sewers, drains or a sump pump,     |
|      |                                       | including backup from a municipal line                                |
| E-44 | Freezing in an unoccupied dwelling    | Freezing of a system while the dwelling was unoccupied for more than  |
|      |                                       | 60 days, unless heat was kept on or the system was drained            |
| E-45 | The part that failed                  | The cost to repair or replace the pipe, fitting or appliance itself;  |
|      |                                       | the water damage it caused stays covered under WE-1                   |
| E-46 | Groundwater                           | Water below the ground surface seeping through foundations, basement  |
|      |                                       | walls or floors                                                       |"}, {"chunk_id": "NG-1101_07-23_sa_chunk_009", "form_number": "NG-1101", "edition": "07-23", "clause_id": "SECTION-III", "text": "SECTION III — YOUR DUTIES AFTER A LOSS
You must shut off the water supply as soon as you discover the escape and
report the loss to us promptly. Keep the failed part for our inspection."}]}
